title: Give the factory dashboard its own wire struct
description:
internal/factory/dashboard/client.go:121 and :168 declare 'Gates []operator.Pending `json:"gates"`'. That is operator.Pending used as a JSON WIRE TYPE in a response from the factory Worker — it was never a tracker call, which is why it looked like a dependency and is not one.

Define the struct in the dashboard package (or a small types file beside it) with the same JSON field names, so the wire format is byte-identical and the deployed Worker needs no change. Confirm the field set against what the Worker actually sends — cloud/factory/src/ is the other end; do not infer it from the Go struct alone, since unused fields may exist on either side.

OWNS: internal/factory/dashboard/client.go and model.go. Do not touch view.go (another tick owns it).
acceptance_criteria: internal/factory/dashboard does not import internal/operator. The JSON wire format is unchanged — same field names, proven against a fixture of a real Worker response. go test ./internal/factory/... green.
